description: This file defines a serializer (TimeSpanCodec) for the TimeSpan data type within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It provides methods to write and read TimeSpan values to and from a binary format, utilizing custom wire protocols and buffer writers.

classes.name: TimeSpanCodec
classes.description: Serializer class for TimeSpan objects in Orleans.Serialization, implementing the IFieldCodec interface for serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: WriteField<TBufferWriter>
methods.description: Serializes a TimeSpan value by writing its ticks as a 64-bit integer with a specific field header.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a TimeSpan value from the reader by reading a 64-bit integer representing ticks.
